notes: 模組自帶部分簡體翻譯（language/zh-CN/dante.txt，73 條），那些條目以它轉成繁體後對照英文修訂；其餘由英文翻譯。
ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_*_NAME/_DESC 是模組在程式裡註冊的武器文字。
鍵是英文句子的條目：模組直接把那段英文當語言 token 使用，沒有另外註冊，所以用英文原文當鍵來翻譯；原文改一個字就會對不上。米斯歷克斯與虛假子嗣遇到但丁時的台詞也屬於這一類。

ROB_DANTE_BODY_DESCRIPTION.en:
<color=#B70027>Dante</color> is a legendary devil hunter who fights with a pair of pistols and a sword.<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! > Ebony & Ivory is a reliable, consistent source of damage.

< ! > Each Devil Arm has a unique moveset, experiment with directional inputs to make the most of them.

< ! > Use Trick to cancel actions and dodge incoming blows.

< ! > Devil Trigger does stuff and things.
ROB_DANTE_BODY_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW:
<color=#B70027>但丁</color>是一名傳奇惡魔獵人，以雙槍和一把劍作戰。<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! >黑檀木與白象牙是可靠而穩定的傷害來源。

< ! >每把惡魔兵器都有獨特的招式，試著搭配方向輸入來充分發揮它們的威力。

< ! >使用詭步可取消動作並閃避來襲的攻擊。

< ! >魔人化會做些有的沒的。

ROB_DANTE_BODY_LORE.en:
Y'kno, I really should scout my jobs better before taking them.

Guy walks into my shop talking about monsters needed killing. Real stiff and proper, probably military. Shotgun where his left arm oughta be. Must mean business.

He throws a bag of money and a ship ticket on the table. This'll have me sitting pretty for months!

But I gotta stay cool, play hard to get.

'Long term job means long term pay.'

'I believe this will change your mind.'

Photo lands on the table. Shows a man trapped in... glass? I can't make out his face, but that pendant I'd know from anywhere.

This guy did his homework. Guess I gotta get on this ship.

'Deal.'

Now I get to hike across the planet cleaning up the trash.

Weeks of searching, killing, surviving.

But I've gotta find <color=#32D2FF>him</color>.

Job's a job, right?

<color=#B70027>Let's rock.</color>
ROB_DANTE_BODY_LORE.zh-TW:
說真的，我接工作之前真該先好好打聽清楚。

有個男的走進我的店裡，說有怪物需要解決。一板一眼、正經八百的，八成是軍人。本該是左臂的地方裝了把霰彈槍。看來是玩真的。

他把一袋錢和一張船票丟到桌上。這夠我逍遙好幾個月了！

不過我得沉住氣，先吊吊他的胃口。

「長期的工作，就要有長期的報酬。」

「我相信這個會讓你改變心意。」

一張照片落在桌上。上面是個男人，被困在……玻璃裡？我看不清他的臉，但那個墜飾我到哪都認得。

這位老兄做足了功課。看來這艘船我是非上不可了。

「成交。」

現在我得徒步橫越這顆星球，一路清理垃圾。

好幾個星期的搜尋、殺戮、求生。

但我非找到<color=#32D2FF>他</color>不可。

工作就是工作，對吧？

<color=#B70027>來搖滾吧。</color>

ROB_SINDANTE_BODY_LORE.zh-TW:
說真的，我接工作之前真該先好好打聽清楚。

有個男的走進我的店裡，說有怪物需要解決。一板一眼、正經八百的，八成是軍人。本該是左臂的地方裝了把霰彈槍。看來是玩真的。

他把一袋錢和一張船票丟到桌上。這夠我逍遙好幾個月了！

不過我得沉住氣，先吊吊他的胃口。

「長期的工作，就要有長期的報酬。」

「我相信這個會讓你改變心意。」

一張照片落在桌上。上面是個男人，被困在……玻璃裡？我看不清他的臉，但那個墜飾我到哪都認得。

這位老兄做足了功課。看來這艘船我是非上不可了。

「成交。」

現在我得徒步橫越這顆星球，一路清理垃圾。

好幾個星期的搜尋、殺戮、求生。

但我非找到<color=#32D2FF>他</color>不可。

工作就是工作，對吧？

<color=#B70027>來搖滾吧。</color>

ROB_SINDANTE_BODY_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.en: <color=#B70027>Dante</color> has access to several <style=cIsDamage>unique abilities</style>. <style=cIsUtility>Hover for more information.</style>
ROB_SINDANTE_BODY_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: <color=#B70027>但丁</color>擁有數種<style=cIsDamage>獨特能力</style>。<style=cIsUtility>將滑鼠移至此處可查看更多資訊。</style>

ROB_SINDANTE_BODY_PRIMARY_DESCRIPTION.en: A crushing <style=cIsDamage>three-stage combo</style> that unleashes the <style=cIsDamage>full might</style> of the <color=#B70027>Devil Sword Dante</color>.
ROB_SINDANTE_BODY_PRIMARY_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 毀滅性的<style=cIsDamage>三段連擊</style>，徹底釋放<color=#B70027>魔劍但丁</color>的<style=cIsDamage>全部威力</style>。

ROB_SINDANTE_BODY_SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION.en: <style=cIsDamage>Energy blasts</color> from your palms slam into the enemy with <style=cIsDamage>terrific force</color>.
ROB_SINDANTE_BODY_SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 從掌心射出<style=cIsDamage>能量彈</color>，以<style=cIsDamage>驚人的力道</color>轟擊敵人。

ROB_SINDANTE_BODY_UTILITY_DESCRIPTION.en: Move at <style=cIsDamage>hyper speed</style>, reaching the enemy in the <style=cIsUtility>blink of an eye</style>.
ROB_SINDANTE_BODY_UTILITY_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 以<style=cIsDamage>超高速</style>移動，<style=cIsUtility>轉瞬之間</style>逼近敵人。

ROB_SINDANTE_BODY_SPECIAL_DESCRIPTION.en: Unleash <style=cIsDamage>all of your power</style> at once, bathing nearby enemies in <style=cIsDamage>lethal damage</style>. <style=cIsHealth>Expends all of your SDT Gauge.</style>
ROB_SINDANTE_BODY_SPECIAL_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 一口氣釋放<style=cIsDamage>你所有的力量</style>，讓附近的敵人承受<style=cIsDamage>致命傷害</style>。<style=cIsHealth>會耗盡你所有的真魔人化量表。</style>

ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_COLOSSUS_DESC.en: A Devil Arm made for melee combat, brimming with the sealed power of the Colossus. <color=#B70027>Upgrades Titan.</color>
ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_COLOSSUS_DESC.zh-TW: 專為近身戰鬥打造的惡魔兵器，充滿被封印的巨像之力。<color=#B70027>可升級巨人。</color>

ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_DSD_DESC.en: A new devil sword born from the fusion of Rebellion and Sparda: the devil sword Dante.
ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_DSD_DESC.zh-TW: 由叛逆之刃與斯巴達融合而生的全新魔劍：魔劍但丁。

ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_MIRAGEEDGE_DESC.en: A weapon shaped from Vergil's own infernal energy. There's something about this blade—its shape and attacks—that resembles Force Edge, the sword his father wielded so long ago.
ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_MIRAGEEDGE_DESC.zh-TW: 以維吉爾自身的魔力塑造而成的武器。這把劍的外形與招式，都隱約有著力之刃的影子——那是他父親許久以前所用的劍。

ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_MITHRIX_DESC.en: The King of Nothing's signature greathammer.

ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_OVERLORD_DESC.en: A powerful blade that can tear holes through dimensions.
ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_OVERLORD_DESC.zh-TW: 能在次元之間撕開裂口的強大利刃。

ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_REBELLION_DESC.en: A keepsake sword from Dante's father. This magic blade hasn't fully awakened.
ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_REBELLION_DESC.zh-TW: 但丁的父親留給他的紀念之劍。這把魔劍尚未完全覺醒。

ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_SPARDA_DESC.en: The sword wielded by Dante and Vergil's father, Sparda. This is the true form of the Force Edge.
ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_SPARDA_DESC.zh-TW: 但丁與維吉爾的父親斯巴達所用的劍。這才是力之刃的真正姿態。

ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_TITAN_DESC.en: Gauntlets with the power of light that have overwhelmingly destructive force.
ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_TITAN_DESC.zh-TW: 蘊含光之力量的拳套，擁有壓倒性的破壞力。

ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_YAMATO_DESC.en: A powerful blade that can separate man from demon.
ROB_DANTE_WEAPON_YAMATO_DESC.zh-TW: 能將人與魔分離的強大利刃。

Again I must face a Sparda; strange fate.en: Again I must face a Sparda; strange fate, isn't it?
Again I must face a Sparda; strange fate.zh-TW: 又要與斯巴達一族交手；命運真是奇妙，不是嗎？

Prepare to suffer, son of Sparda..en: Prepare to suffer, son of Sparda.
Prepare to suffer, son of Sparda..zh-TW: 準備受苦吧，斯巴達之子。

We meet again, son of Sparda..en: We meet again, son of Sparda.
We meet again, son of Sparda..zh-TW: 我們又見面了，斯巴達之子。

You will suffer, son of Sparda..en: You will suffer, son of Sparda.
You will suffer, son of Sparda..zh-TW: 你將受盡苦難，斯巴達之子。
